design: Money Station black/green, animated headlines, actual UI and short English captions
scope: Actual app UI. Sample wallet/API and chain-context fixtures; actual local Groth16 proof, encrypted receipt and source-bound outline. Real unmodified wallet selector without authentication. No public USDC, live tax/AI provider or professional approval is represented.

chapters.title: Business is private.
chapters.narration: Invoices, payroll, and supplier relationships. Business details should stay with the people who need them.

chapters.title: Fast money.
chapters.narration: Moving money is only half the job. Finance teams still need a clear paper trail.

chapters.title: Private payments.
chapters.narration: Meet Money Station. Private business payments, with evidence you choose to share.

chapters.title: Start with an invoice.
chapters.narration: Create a signed payment request. Share one link with your customer or business partner.

chapters.title: Connect. Keep control.
chapters.scope: Actual wallet selector · No payment signed
chapters.narration: Connect a supported wallet. Your signing keys stay with your wallet provider.

chapters.title: Choose your private note.
chapters.narration: Open an encrypted note from its original payment group. Its secrets stay on your device.

chapters.title: Prove it. Privately.
chapters.scope: Actual local proof · Sample chain context
chapters.narration: Generate the proof locally. Authorize the payout without revealing the input note.

chapters.title: Review. Then approve.
chapters.narration: Check the recipient, full principal, and added fee. Approve each required wallet call.

chapters.title: Follow the confirmation.
chapters.narration: Track the original payment through confirmation. An uncertain response never triggers an automatic second payment.

chapters.title: Share only what’s needed.
chapters.narration: Choose the amount, asset, or invoice reference to disclose. Keep unrelated business information private.

chapters.title: Ready for finance.
chapters.narration: Prepare a cited tax procedure draft, then request independent review. Keep preparation separate from approval.

chapters.title: Business money.
chapters.narration: Money Station. Private payments. Clear proof. Your business stays yours.
